messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: sampleapp onboarding failing in CI when creating admin routes via Node SDK. REST-created routes show "max_concurrency": 12 but SDK-created ones end up effectively single-threaded (concurrency 1).

alberto: can repro. SDK call uses `concurrency` in payload but server RPC expects `max_concurrency`. REST layer translates for curl clients; SDK is sending raw field so server ignores it.

priya: bad DX because quickstart examples use SDK by default. New users get underprovisioned chat routes silently.

nina: repro steps (minimal):
```js
// node sdk v2.5.0-rc
await admin.createRoute({ serviceId: 'sampleapp', name: 'chat', model: 'redwood-1.1', concurrency: 12 });
```
then `GET /admin/routes/:id` -> shows `max_concurrency` absent and route defaults to 1.

alberto: short-term fix: bootstrap can call REST with explicit `max_concurrency` field.

ci-bot: CI job triggered for branch fix/sdk-param-map (#2023) 1:05:02 UTC.

priya: proposal: patch SDK to accept both `concurrency` and `max_concurrency` and normalize to `max_concurrency` in outgoing request. Add deprecation log when `concurrency` used for two releases.

nina: also noticed SDK retry semantics differ: SDK does not retry on 429 for admin endpoints, while our REST quickstarts wrap requests with retries/backoff. That causes bootstrap to fail under rate limits.

alberto: server supports idempotency-key dedupe. Suggest SDK auto-generate `Idempotency-Key` for mutating admin ops and retry on 429 with exponential backoff if header present. Must coordinate with eng-runtime to ensure server honors dedupe.

eng-runtime-bot: ticket ENG-5405 created: "admin createRoute idempotency + 429 retry behavior".

priya: created DX ticket DX-4120 with repro steps, rollout plan: 1) param mapping patch (quick 2.5.1 release), 2) idempotency+retry in 2.6.0 after server dedupe validation.

nina: adding a note to sampleapp README and quickstart script with REST workaround until SDK patch rolls out.

alberto: PR incoming for param mapping; will include unit + integration tests.

ci-bot: Merge completed for fix/sdk-param-map -> main. Release candidate 2.5.1-rc published.

priya: thanks — will update support playbook so CS can triage onboarding failures referencing `concurrency` vs `max_concurrency`. :thumbsup:
